base_national_dex_species.rule: For base species, SPECIES_* ID equals National Dex number.

gameplay_varieties.purpose: Regional forms, Mega/Primal and other battle-distinct varieties.

form_id.policy: Independent form registry; cosmetic forms may share gameplay variety/species data.

dex_save_strategy.note: 4095 Seen/Caught flags fit in existing SaveBlock2 filler without increasing SaveBlock2 size if stock flag arrays are retained and only extension bytes are placed in filler.

required_engine_changes: Remove OLD_UNOWN_B-Z reserved Species IDs and remap all stock references so base species IDs 1-386 equal National Dex numbers.
Reserve 1-4095 for base National Dex species and 4096-8191 for gameplay varieties.
Decouple National Dex number, gameplay Species/Variety ID and cosmetic Form ID.
Expand ability identifiers from u8 to u16 where required and support at least Ability1/Ability2/Hidden Ability.
Expand base EXP yield from u8 to u16.
Replace fixed five-evolutions-per-species table with variable-length records/pointers.
Replace 9-bit packed level-up move format with u16 move IDs and variable-length learnsets.
Expand Pokédex rendering/search/loops to 4-digit entries and future 4095 cap.
Store extended Seen/Caught bits in existing SaveBlock2 filler.
Implement generalized form/variety mapping rather than Castform/Deoxys-only special cases.
Use language-specific link layouts; do not assume the same free-space offsets across BPRE/BPRJ/BPRD/BPRF/BPRI/BPRS.

binary_policy.reason: Repository stores only source, analysis, hashes, manifests, and independently generated patch data; original/copyrighted ROM binaries are excluded.
